name: Field Garlic
caution: THE ONION RULE HAS NO EXCEPTIONS: if it does not smell strongly of onion or garlic, do not eat it. Toxic look-alikes grow in the same lawns but have no smell. Never eat a wild plant on this guide's word alone. Confirm identity against several sources and learn the look-alikes first.

sections.title: Identification
sections.body: Round hollow grass-like leaves in a clump, and the giveaway: crush one and the whole plant must reek of garlic. No smell, no eating.

sections.title: In the kitchen
sections.body: The green tops are wild chives and the little bulbs are a sharp garlic; both go into anything savory.
